assessment: This study presents fundamental insights into the relationship between [18F]-FDOPA PET measurements of striatal dopamine synthesis capacity and a series of measures, including behavioral readouts, proposed to index dopamine function. The frequentist and Bayesian analyses together provide compelling evidence for an absence of any relationship between striatal dopamine synthesis capacity and external measures, questioning the interpretation of studies using such measures to index dopamine function. These findings will not only be of great interest to cognitive neuroscientists but also inform future studies of neuropsychiatric diseases.
